author: KEXP
description:
Under the musical project Primitive Ring, Bert Hoover, Jon Modaff, and Charles Moothart unleash a veil of high-energy, heavy psych. Fresh off the release of their self-titled debut, the band hit the KEXP Live Room with a performance of "Heads Will Roll" and more.

Watch the listener-powered in-studio session on our YouTube channel.
title: Primitive Ring performs "Heads Will Roll" & more Live on KEXP
